spec_family.name: Interior Drywall Wall Repaint
spec_family.description: Combined prime + finish repaint spec for previously painted interior drywall wall surfaces in occupied residential homes. Covers condition assessment (visual scan, adhesion test, moisture meter, coating ID), prep remediation (degloss, scrape, feather, contamination treatment), state-driven primer selection (adhesion, stain-block, mildew-resistant), finish coat application (roll, spray_backroll, spray), interstage inspection/repair, and furniture/contents protection. First interior repaint spec in the system.

includes: Condition assessment (visual scan, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, moisture meter, coating ID, caulk assessment)
EPA Lead-Safe RRP evaluation and containment for pre-1978 homes
Surface contamination treatment (TSP wash for mildew, smoke, water stain, grease)
Mildew/biocide treatment for SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE
Scraping loose and failing paint (condition-driven intensity)
Feather-sanding all scraped edges (mandatory at all QT)
Deglossing existing paint surface (chemical or mechanical)
Spackle wall defects and sand repairs (QT3+)
Caulk assessment and replacement at trim junctions (QT3+)
State-driven primer selection and application (adhesion, stain-block, mildew-resistant)
Spot priming all spackled/scraped areas
Finish coat application — 1 coat QT2, 2 coats QT3-QT5 (roll, spray_backroll, spray)
Interstage inspection, light sanding (QT4/QT5), and defect repair
Final inspection and touch-up
Floor protection (perimeter for roll, full for spray methods)
Trim edge masking (baseboard, door casing, window casing — always required in RP)
Fixture covers (spray methods or QT4+ roll)
Furniture moving, covering, and replacement (occupied homes)
Floor vacuum and tool cleaning
Customer walkthrough (occupied homes)

excludes.item: Structural drywall repair (holes, water damage to substrate)

excludes.route_to: Plumber/contractor — moisture SOURCE must be resolved before painting (gate condition)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling coat count, inspection rigor, edge discipline, and interstage sanding. QT2 included as economy refresh tier (most common residential RP scenario).
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2=1 finish coat, relaxed edges, quick inspect, roll-only. QT3=2 coats default, standard edges. QT4=2 coats mandatory, interstage sand, systematic inspect. QT5=2 coats, full interstage, critical raking-light inspect. QT modifier values: QT2=0.80, QT3=1.00, QT4=1.30, QT5=1.50.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique. Roll is primary for occupied interior RP. Spray methods available at QT3+.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Roll: QT2-QT5 (most common). spray_backroll: QT3-QT5 (requires room clearing). spray: QT4-QT5 (rare in occupied). Spray/backroll coupling constraint: spray rate <= backroll rate.

configuration_dimensions.description: Finish coating sheen level. Determines output substrate state.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Eggshell is standard for residential walls. Satin and semi-gloss require QT4+. Gloss excluded for walls (trim-only per doctrine).

configuration_dimensions.description: Universal 3-level condition scale driving prep intensity. Maps from substrate state assessment.
configuration_dimensions.notes: GOOD=SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT (1.0x prep). FAIR=SS_INT_FAILING_PAINT or SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE (1.3-1.8x prep). POOR=SS_INT_PEELING or SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE (2.0-3.0x prep).

paintable_items.name: Wall Field Repaint Surface
paintable_items.counting_rules: Square footage of wall surface measured at finished face. Deduct window and door openings >16 SF per PCA standard.
paintable_items.notes: Combined prime+finish RP item. _RP suffix avoids collision with NC ITM_WALL_FIELD_PRIME.

paintable_items.name: Ceiling Edge Cut-In (from wall perspective)
paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear footage of wall-to-ceiling junction. Measured at room perimeter minus openings.
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from NC wall prime. Same physical edge work applies in RP context.

variants.notes: Fastest path. Economy refresh on sound paint. 1 finish coat, no prime. Rental turnover scenario.
BASELINE. Most common residential wall repaint. Degloss + 2 finish coats. No prime needed.
Standard repaint on failing/moisture-damaged walls. Scrape + feather + spot/full prime + 2 finish coats.
Full remediation. Heavy scrape + full adhesion/stain-block prime + 2 finish coats. Highest prep labor.
Premium refresh. Spray+backroll with interstage sanding. Full room protection required.
Premium remediation. Full prep + interstage sand between finish coats. Semi-gloss or satin.
Maximum effort. Full remediation + critical quality. Near-worst-case labor scenario.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Total square footage of wall surfaces to be repainted
Linear footage of wall-to-ceiling junction for cut-in work
Linear footage of wall-to-trim junction (baseboard, casing) for cut-in at tape line
Floor area for perimeter drop cloth protection (roll method)
Full floor area for spray protection coverage
Total room count driving per-room fixed tasks (assessment, furniture, fixtures, walkthrough)
Furniture protection area in occupied homes
Linear footage of trim edges requiring masking tape (baseboard, door casing, window casing)
Condition scale (GOOD/FAIR/POOR) — primary prep intensity driver
Wall surface texture (smooth/orange_peel/knockdown/heavy_texture) — drives texture modifier
Wall height tier (H1/H2/H3/H4) — drives height modifier
Interior substrate state (SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT through SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE) — drives primer selection and prep pathway
Pre-1978 home flag — triggers EPA Lead-Safe RRP module
Contamination type (none/mildew/smoke/water_stain/grease) — drives contamination treatment tasks and modifier

material_systems_summary.name: Interior Adhesion Primer
material_systems_summary.notes: Water-based adhesion promoter for previously painted surfaces. Bonds to glossy, chalky, or oil-based existing coatings.

material_systems_summary.name: Interior Stain-Blocking Primer (Shellac)
material_systems_summary.notes: Shellac-based stain blocker (BIN or equivalent). Only product that seals nicotine/smoke. Full surface application required.

material_systems_summary.name: Interior Mildew-Resistant Primer
material_systems_summary.notes: Mildew-resistant stain-blocking primer. Applied after biocide treatment and source moisture resolution.

material_systems_summary.name: Interior Finish — Standard (QT2-QT3)
material_systems_summary.notes: Standard interior wall finish. Eggshell or flat sheen.

material_systems_summary.name: Interior Finish — Premium (QT4)
material_systems_summary.notes: Premium interior wall finish. Higher solids, better hide, satin or semi-gloss.

material_systems_summary.name: Interior Finish — Superior (QT5)
material_systems_summary.notes: Superior interior wall finish. Maximum film build, self-leveling, semi-gloss.

module_summary.description: Floor, trim masking, fixture covers, furniture protection
Condition scan, adhesion test, moisture meter, coating ID
Lead test, containment setup, HEPA vacuum, containment removal, waste disposal (conditional: pre-1978)
TSP wash, mildew treatment, scrape, feather, degloss, spackle, sand, caulk, dust wipe/vacuum
Cut-in primer at ceiling, roll primer, spray primer, backroll primer, spot prime
Light sand, vacuum intercoat dust, inspect between coats, patch defects, spot coat
Cut-in ceiling R1/R2, cut-in trim R1/R2, roll finish R1/R2, spray finish R1/R2, backroll finish R1/R2
Remove masking, fixture covers, floor teardown, furniture replace, vacuum, clean tools, final inspect, touchup, customer walkthrough

Economy Refresh — No Prime + 1 Finish Coat

stacking_partition.prep_pool: condition x contamination x access x height x texture (max 9.75x)
stacking_partition.coating_pool: qt x access x height x texture (max 4.88x)
stacking_partition.never_cross: Prep pool never includes QT. Coating pool never includes condition or contamination.

protection_zones_required.notes: Perimeter drop cloths for drip risk during roll application.
Full floor coverage for spray methods. Rosin paper on hard floors, plastic on carpet.
RP trim always in place. Tape line at baseboard, door casing, and window casing edges.
Outlets, switches, and wall-mounted fixtures. Also recommended for roll at QT4+.
RP-specific. Furniture center-piled and covered with poly sheeting.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Wall painter establishes ceiling line via freehand cut-in. No tape/mask on drywall ceilings per doctrine.
Baseboard always in place in RP. Masked off, wall painter cuts to tape line.
Door casing always in place in RP. Masked off, wall painter cuts to tape line.
Window casing always in place in RP. Masked off, wall painter cuts to tape line.
If crown exists, masked before wall work. Wall painter cuts to tape line at crown bottom edge.
If chair rail exists, masked. May split wall into upper/lower sections with different colors.

valid_input_states.notes: All 5 SS_INT_* states accepted. Each drives distinct prep pathway and primer selection. Worst state in room drives overall condition_scale.

output_state.notes: All input states normalize to SS_PAINTED_* output after proper prep and coating. Eggshell is default.

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: Per doctrine: walls always cut into ceilings freehand. No tape/mask on drywall ceilings.
RP trim always finished. Tape line at baseboard top edge provides cut-in target.
Door casing always present in RP. Tape line at casing edge.
Window casing always present in RP. Tape line at casing edge.

site_condition_rules.notes: Occupied home adds furniture protection and customer walkthrough. Vacant RP omits these tasks.
active_moisture is STOP WORK. recently_wet requires extended dry time.
Contamination type drives TSP wash and biocide treatment activation.
Per Modifier_Registry. Applied to all tasks based on working height.
Texture increases surface area and slows application rate.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup (protect) -> Assess (condition) -> RRP (if pre-1978) -> Prep (state-driven) -> Prime (state-driven) -> Interstage (QT4/QT5) -> Finish 1 -> Interstage (QT4/QT5) -> Finish 2 (QT3+) -> Inspect -> Touch-up -> Teardown -> Cleanup -> Customer Walkthrough
sequencing_notes.edge_work: Wall-to-ceiling cut-in is the primary edge work. All trim edges are masked (protection relationship, not edge work).
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO spray primer without backroll (adhesion mandatory). NO masking drywall ceilings. NO painting over active moisture. NO latex primer on smoke damage (shellac only). Spot prime ALL spackled/scraped areas regardless of full prime.

relationships.notes: First interior repaint spec. Combined prime+finish (no separate phases). NC wall prime/finish are sibling specs with significant task reuse (~49 direct transfers).

sections_used: Shellac stain-blocker mandate for smoke damage
